ops.body: - **Every card capture listed at its place, wherever taken** (fix poi-any-distance, decision 0247; the owner's call, Nov 20: "fix now, slice later"). A place's card offers Camera, Voice and Note at any distance, but a moment keeps only its spot, so a found card's "Moments here" lists moments within 60 m plus the one that found it; a later capture from a found card far off (the Washington Monument from across the Mall) is not listed. Storing the place on each card capture is a new stored link with a SQLite migration and an IndexedDB version, reversing 0246's "no new stored link": a `/slice`.
